intent_contract.text: 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Independently invent a complex, random-feeling but photographically coherent Lunarpunk scene whose lunar, regenerative-ecology, and bioluminescent cues can later be judged in rendered pixels, while using the supplied portrait only to guide the adult subject's visible appearance.

A high-detail Lunarpunk editorial night photograph of an unmistakably adult woman, her facial appearance and long wavy dark hair guided only by the supplied portrait, working as a lunar-tide ecologist at a floating wetland observatory. Beneath a huge visible crescent moon, she pours glowing blue-green algae culture from a handblown glass vessel into a crescent-shaped translucent bioreactor; the transfer visibly ignites pearlescent mycelium conduits woven through reeds and lily pools. She wears an indigo grown-fiber utility coat embroidered with lunar-phase arcs, seed capsules, and shell-fastened tools. Silver dew collectors, moon-phase gauges, moss-covered ceramic instruments, and living vine pipes make the station feel handcrafted yet advanced. The surrounding marsh is dark, misty, and thriving, lit by cool moonlight, bioluminescent fungi, and reflected violet-blue water. Photorealistic skin, tactile natural materials, credible working ecology, subtle grain, complex environmental storytelling.
